description: Full-text search over story cluster headlines and excerpts, ranked by relevance. Returns matching story clusters with coverage links, discussion link counts, and TechSnif article references when available. Use get_story for full detail and article body text. Optionally filter by publisher and paginate with offset.

platform.description: Narrow displayed discussion links to this platform (e.g. "x", "bluesky")

query.description: Search query, matches story headlines and excerpts (min 2 characters)
